name: youth-sports-dental-injury-database
title: Youth Sports Dental Injury Database
description: Harmonized open-access database of dental and orofacial injury epidemiology in youth sports (ages 5-22): 421 data points from 103 sources (peer-reviewed studies, national injury surveillance, and governing-body reports) across 28 countries. Each row is one extracted statistic with population, exposure, outcome, mouthguard, comparability, provenance, and dental-specificity metadata.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the source. Format: <lastname><year> or <surveillance><year>

fields.name: citation
fields.description: Full citation in APA format

fields.name: doi
fields.description: DOI if available; empty if none

fields.name: pub_year
fields.description: Publication year

fields.name: study_type
fields.description: One of: surveillance, cross_sectional, cohort, case_series, registry, governing_body_report

fields.name: peer_reviewed
fields.description: TRUE if published in a peer-reviewed venue

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

fields.name: region
fields.description: Sub-national region if reported

fields.name: population_setting
fields.description: One of: school, club, recreational, professional, mixed, unspecified

fields.name: age_min
fields.description: Minimum age in sample (years)

fields.name: age_max
fields.description: Maximum age in sample (years)

fields.name: age_category
fields.description: One of: youth (5–12), adolescent (13–17), collegiate (18–22), adult (23+ — see "Adult comparator rows" below), mixed, unspecified. See PROTOCOL §6.2 for rules when sample spans categories.

fields.name: extraction_basis
fields.description: youth_primary (row is within the v1.0 inclusion scope of 5–22) or adult_comparator (row was extracted alongside the youth data for context — see "Adult comparator rows" below).

fields.name: sex
fields.description: One of: male, female, mixed, unspecified

fields.name: level_of_play
fields.description: One of: recreational, school_jv, school_varsity, club, elite, mixed, unspecified

fields.name: sport_raw
fields.description: Sport as named in the source

fields.name: sport
fields.description: Standardized sport name per controlled vocabulary (see docs/decisions.md)

fields.name: sport_category
fields.description: One of: contact, limited_contact, non_contact. See docs/decisions.md for assignment rules.

fields.name: exposure_context
fields.description: Which activity context the row's data describes: all (combined / not stratified), competition, practice, training, other. Empty when the row is not exposure-stratified at all (e.g., a one-shot prevalence survey). See "Exposure context and subgroup rows" below.

fields.name: subgroup_label
fields.description: Short snake_case label for any *within-source* subgroup that isn't already captured by sex / age_category / level_of_play / sport / exposure_context. Used for protective-equipment splits (mouthguard_users, mouthguard_nonusers), helmet groups, special populations (with_orthodontic_appliance), etc. Empty when the row is the source's main/pooled estimate. See "Exposure context and subgroup rows" below.

fields.name: sample_size
fields.description: Number of individuals in sample

fields.name: athlete_exposures
fields.description: Total athlete-exposures (athlete × session) if reported; empty if not

fields.name: season_or_timeframe
fields.description: Data collection period

fields.name: injury_count
fields.description: Number of dental/orofacial injuries reported

fields.name: injury_type_raw
fields.description: Injury terminology as used in source

fields.name: injury_category
fields.description: Standardized per Andreasen classification: enamel_fracture, crown_fracture, root_fracture, luxation, avulsion, concussion, other_dental, orofacial_with_dental, unspecified_dental

fields.name: rate_raw
fields.description: Rate as reported in source (in the source's own denominator)

fields.name: rate_denominator_raw
fields.description: Original denominator phrasing — describes rate_raw, not rate_per_1000_ae.

fields.name: mouthguard_required
fields.description: Whether mouthguards were mandated in the studied population: yes, no, unspecified

fields.name: mouthguard_use_rate
fields.description: Proportion of sample using mouthguards (0–1); empty if not reported

fields.name: mouthguard_injury_relation
fields.description: Whether source analyzed mouthguard use vs. injury: analyzed, mentioned_only, not_addressed

fields.name: extraction_date
fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: extractor
fields.description: Initials of extractor

fields.name: extraction_notes
fields.description: Any extraction-time notes; empty if none

fields.name: quality_flag
fields.description: One of: clean, assumption_made, partial_data, review_needed

fields.name: measure_type
fields.description: The row's outcome-measure / rate basis. One of: incidence_per_AE (per athlete-exposure; the directly-comparable rate tier, normalized in rate_per_1000_ae), incidence_per_exposure_hours (per player/athlete/match-hours), incidence_per_population (per 100,000 population, not AE), incidence_per_season (per season / player-year), prevalence_proportion (a reported proportion/percentage — of a sample or of injuries; check rate_denominator_raw for the proportion's population before pooling), mouthguard_

fields.name: comparability_group
fields.description: Coarse key on which direct comparison is permitted: the short measure_type family, suffixed __aggregate for pooled / non-sport-specific rows (all_sports_aggregate, etc.). Two rows are directly comparable only when they share the same comparability_group. Rate magnitudes still differ by scale within incidence_per_AE — use rate_per_1000_ae for those.

fields.name: data_provenance
fields.description: Redistribution-rights class of the row's source. One of: public_domain_raw (extracted from public-domain raw data — NEISS/CPSC), published_summary (summary statistics reported in a peer-reviewed paper), governing_body_public (figures from a public governing-body report). The database holds no raw/restricted microdata (e.g. no raw NCAA-ISP, RIO, or ACC datasets). See PROTOCOL.md §12 and LICENSE-DATA.

fields.name: dental_specific
fields.description: Whether the row's outcome is a dental/orofacial injury measure. FALSE marks the small number of rows (~19) whose stored value is a broader all-cause / head-neck / composite injury measure from a study whose injury definition merely *included* dental (e.g. collegiate rugby all-injury incidence) — these must not be read or compared as dental injury rates.
